messages:
Ravi: ok hear me out  We need an official LLM cafeteria chant for when someone steals your lunch.
Maya: priceless. what does it sound like tho. humming model weights? :notes:
Noor: chorus: "Who trained your sandwich, who tuned your mayo?
Was it finetuned on leftovers from yesterday?
We call the keys, we flush the cache, bring back my lunch and i'll say grace."
Ben: chorus 2 suggestion: "I gave you my Tupperware, you returned a null.
Please unblock my fridge, be kind, not pull." :sob:
Ravi: I like the cache flush line. can we add lines anthropomorphizing models: "My fridge is a small transformer, it attends to snacks,
But someone masked its labels, now my lunch lacks facts."
Maya: would prefer shorter lines for chanting. maybe a call-and-response:
Ravi: Call: Who took my lunch?
Group: Not my model!
Noor: Response: Restore the weights!
Group: Give back the bowl!
Ben: DeployBot, can you make a meme gif from this? maybe overlay text on a server rack heating up.
DeployBot: Generated meme: https://img.internal/memes/llm-fridge-01.gif :robot_face: (auto-expiry 24h)
Maya: also can we add a tiny ritual: every Friday at 4pm we run "fridge-audit --open-lids" and recite the chant.
Noor: emoji poll: :1: for call-and-response, :2: for paragraph-chant, :3: for haiku-fridge
Ravi: 1
Maya: 1
Ben: 3 (haiku vibes)
Noor: tally is leaning call-and-response. I'll make a sticky note with lyrics and tape it to the microwave.
Maya: ok now someone actually bring my lunch from the fridge pls i'm serious :pleading_face:
